controlled_variable: static branch priority suffix after the Q1467 target-preimage selectors
inputs: Q1467 exact selector, pair-midpoint, and leaf IDs; Q1466 exact N53/N83 original and width-four XCNFs

modes.selector_pair_mids: selectors, then all first pair-midpoint bits and all second pair-midpoint bits, then remaining IDs ascending
modes.selector_mid_interleave: selectors, then corresponding bits of the two pair midpoints, then remaining IDs ascending
modes.selector_leaf_interleave: selectors, then corresponding bits of the four leaf points, then remaining IDs ascending

solver.baseline: Q1467 selector-first on identical inputs and limits
solver.branch_metric: four WDSat conf[0]++ left-branch sites; propagation and field operations are separate
